ns1:hasLotAwardCombination owl:DatatypeProperty Has lot award combination@en skos:definition The contracting authority reserves the right to award contracts combining lots or groups of lots. Additional Information: This property contains information about the Lots concerned. This property is required by the regulation (EU)-2015-1986 (modeled in the TED Standard Forms). WG approval 23/08/2022 (epo:ProcedureTerm)@en The contracting authority reserves the right to award contracts combining lots or groups of lots. Additional Information: This property contains information about the Lots concerned. This property is required by the regulation (EU)-2015-1986 (modeled in the TED Standard Forms). (epo:ProcedureTerm)@en
ns1:hasMainActivityDescription owl:DatatypeProperty Has main activity description@en skos:definition Self-explanatory text about the Main Activity . Additional information: This field is used when the Main Activity is not available in the controlled list at-voc:main-activity-type . This is necessary in to cover data provided in the TED Standard Forms. It shall be deprecated in the future. WG Approval 06/09/2022 (org:Organization)@en Self-explanatory text about the Main Activity . Additional information: This field is used when the Main Activity is not available in the controlled list at-voc:main-activity-type . This is necessary in to cover data provided in the TED Standard Forms. It shall be deprecated in the future. (org:Organization)@en
ns1:hasMaximumLotSubmissionAllowed owl:DatatypeProperty Has maximum lot submission allowed@en skos:definition The total number of lots for which one Tenderer can submit Tenders. Additional information: This field is used to complement the SubmissionTerms (which are at the Lot level) for the Procedure level which is covered by the regulation (EU)-2015-1986 (modeled in the TED Standard Forms). WG approval 12/12/2018 (epo:ProcedureTerm)@en The total number of lots for which one Tenderer can submit Tenders. Additional information: This field is used to complement the SubmissionTerms (which are at the Lot level) for the Procedure level which is covered by the regulation (EU)-2015-1986 (modeled in the TED Standard Forms). (epo:ProcedureTerm)@en
ns1:hasMaximumNumberOfCandidates owl:DatatypeProperty Has maximum number of candidates@en skos:definition Maximum number of candidates to be invited for the second stage of the procedure. WG Approval 22/08/2019 (epo:MultipleStageProcedureTerm)@en Maximum number of candidates to be invited for the second stage of the procedure. (epo:MultipleStageProcedureTerm)@en
ns1:hasMaximumNumberOfLotsToBeAwarded owl:DatatypeProperty Has maximum number of lots to be awarded@en skos:definition The maximum number of lots for which contract(s) can be awarded to one tenderer. Additional information: This field is used to complement the SubmissionTerms (which are at the Lot level) for the Procedure level which is covered by the regulation (EU)-2015-1986 (modeled in the TED Standard Forms). WG Approval 22/08/2019 (epo:ProcedureTerm)@en The maximum number of lots for which contract(s) can be awarded to one tenderer. Additional information: This field is used to complement the SubmissionTerms (which are at the Lot level) for the Procedure level which is covered by the regulation (EU)-2015-1986 (modeled in the TED Standard Forms). (epo:ProcedureTerm)@en
ns1:hasMaximumParticipantsNumber owl:DatatypeProperty Has maximum participants number@en skos:definition The maximum number of participants in the framework agreement. Additional Information: Maximum number of tenderers who may be awarded a contract within the framework agreement. The number is a positive integer. This corresponds in eForms to BT-113 Framework Maximum Participants Number. WG Approval 2019-02-05 (epo:FrameworkAgreementTerm)@en The maximum number of participants in the framework agreement. Additional Information: Maximum number of tenderers who may be awarded a contract within the framework agreement. The number is a positive integer. (epo:FrameworkAgreementTerm)@en
ns1:hasMaximumShare owl:DatatypeProperty Has maximum share@en skos:definition The maximum proportion of something to be distributed. Additional Information: In the case of subcontracting the share may refer to the proportion of works, services or supplies being subcontracted. WG Approval 17/09/2019 (epo:SubcontractTerm)@en The maximum proportion of something to be distributed. Additional Information: In the case of subcontracting the share may refer to the proportion of works, services or supplies being subcontracted. (epo:SubcontractTerm)@en
ns1:hasMinimumNumberOfCandidates owl:DatatypeProperty Has minimum number of candidates@en skos:definition Minimum number of candidates to be invited for the second stage of the procedure. WG Approval 22/08/2019 (epo:MultipleStageProcedureTerm)@en Minimum number of candidates to be invited for the second stage of the procedure. (epo:MultipleStageProcedureTerm)@en
ns1:hasMinimumShare owl:DatatypeProperty Has minimum share@en skos:definition The minimum proportion of something to be distributed. Additional Information: In the case of subcontracting the share may refer to the proportion of works, services or supplies being subcontracted. WG Approval 17/09/2019 (epo:SubcontractTerm)@en The minimum proportion of something to be distributed. Additional Information: In the case of subcontracting the share may refer to the proportion of works, services or supplies being subcontracted. (epo:SubcontractTerm)@en
ns1:hasMinimumSubcontractorsProposedObligation owl:DatatypeProperty Has minimum subcontractors proposed obligation@en skos:definition The minimum percentage of the contract value that the contractor must subcontract. Additional information: This is used for the competitive procedure described in Title III of Directive 2009/81/EC. WG Approval 09/11/2021 (epo:SubcontractTerm)@en The minimum percentage of the contract value that the contractor must subcontract. Additional information: This is used for the competitive procedure described in Title III of Directive 2009/81/EC. (epo:SubcontractTerm)@en
ns1:hasNonAccessibilityCriterionJustification owl:DatatypeProperty Has non accessibility criterion justification@en skos:definition Reason for not applying accessibility criteria. Additional information: This corresponds in eForma to BT-755 Accessibility Justification. WG Approval 05/03/2019 (epo:StrategicProcurement)@en Reason for not applying accessibility criteria. (epo:StrategicProcurement)@en
ns1:hasNonAwardedContractNumber owl:DatatypeProperty Has non awarded contract number@en skos:definition The number the contract would have had if it had been awarded. Additional information: This field is provided to support the data provided in the TED Standard Forms, and it should be discontinued in the future. WG agreement: 06/09/2022 (epo:LotAwardOutcome)@en The number the contract would have had if it had been awarded. Additional information: This field is provided to support the data provided in the TED Standard Forms, and it should be discontinued in the future. (epo:LotAwardOutcome)@en
ns1:hasNonAwardedContractTitle owl:DatatypeProperty Has non awarded contract title@en skos:definition The title the contract would have had if it had been awarded. Additional information: This field is provided to support the data provided in the TED Standard Forms, and it should be discontinued in the future. WG agreement: 06/09/2022 (epo:LotAwardOutcome)@en The title the contract would have had if it had been awarded. Additional information: This field is provided to support the data provided in the TED Standard Forms, and it should be discontinued in the future. (epo:LotAwardOutcome)@en
ns1:hasNonEEAReceivedTenders owl:DatatypeProperty Has non e e a received tenders@en skos:definition The amount of tenders received from economic operators in non-EEA countries. WG Approval 12/12/2019 15:20:36 (epo:SubmissionStatisticalInformation)@en The amount of tenders received from economic operators in non-EEA countries. (epo:SubmissionStatisticalInformation)@en
ns1:hasNonElectronicSubmissionDescription owl:DatatypeProperty Has non electronic submission description@en skos:definition Textual explanation of how non-electronic information is to be presented. WG Approval 21/07/2020 (epo:SubmissionTerm)@en Textual explanation of how non-electronic information is to be presented. (epo:SubmissionTerm)@en
ns1:hasNumberOfTenderersInvited owl:DatatypeProperty Has number of tenderers invited@en skos:definition Number of economic operators invited to tender. Additional Information This may be used for single-stage procedures or to indicate the number of candidates invited to tender in multi-stage procedures. WG Approval 01/12/2020 (epo:SubmissionStatisticalInformation)@en Number of economic operators invited to tender. Additional Information This may be used for single-stage procedures or to indicate the number of candidates invited to tender in multi-stage procedures. (epo:SubmissionStatisticalInformation)@en
ns1:hasOpeningDateTime owl:DatatypeProperty Has opening date time@en skos:definition Date and time for the opening of tenders. WG Approval 12/03/2019 (epo:OpeningTerm)@en Date and time for the opening of tenders. (epo:OpeningTerm)@en
ns1:hasOpeningDescription owl:DatatypeProperty Has opening description@en skos:definition Further information about the opening of tenders. Additional Information For example, who may participate in the opening and whether any authorization is needed. WG Approval 12/03/2019 (epo:OpeningTerm)@en Further information about the opening of tenders. Additional Information For example, who may participate in the opening and whether any authorization is needed. (epo:OpeningTerm)@en
ns1:hasOpeningURL owl:DatatypeProperty Has opening u r l@en skos:definition The identifier of the address of the Opening of Tenders. WG Approval 09/11/2021 (epo:OpeningTerm)@en The identifier of the address of the Opening of Tenders. (epo:OpeningTerm)@en
ns1:hasOptionsDescription owl:DatatypeProperty Has options description@en skos:definition The motivation and details about additional purchases that the buyer may undertake while the contract is valid. WG Approval 09/04/2019 (epo:ContractTerm)@en The motivation and details about additional purchases that the buyer may undertake while the contract is valid. (epo:ContractTerm)@en
ns1:hasParticipationPayment owl:DatatypeProperty Has participation payment@en skos:definition Details on payments to participants WG Approval 09/11/2021 (epo:DesignContestRegimeTerm)@en Details on payments to participants (epo:DesignContestRegimeTerm)@en
ns1:hasPerformanceConditions owl:DatatypeProperty Has performance conditions@en skos:definition The particular conditions and additional information related to the execution of the contract. Additional Information: For example, specific information about the place of performance, intermediary deliverables, compensation for damages, intellectual property rights. WG approval 15-01-2019 (epo:ContractTerm)@en The particular conditions and additional information related to the execution of the contract. Additional Information: For example, specific information about the place of performance, intermediary deliverables, compensation for damages, intellectual property rights. (epo:ContractTerm)@en
ns1:hasPlaceOfPerformanceAdditionalInformation owl:DatatypeProperty Has place of performance additional information@en skos:definition Further details on the location of the execution of the contract. WG Approval 30/07/2019 (epo:ContractTerm)@en Further details on the location of the execution of the contract. (epo:ContractTerm)@en
ns1:hasPrizeRank owl:DatatypeProperty Has prize rank@en skos:definition The position of the prize (e.g. first place, second place) in a design contest list of prizes. WG Approval 29/08/2019 (epo:Prize)@en The position of the prize (e.g. first place, second place) in a design contest list of prizes. (epo:Prize)@en
ns1:hasProcurementDocumentChangeDate owl:DatatypeProperty Has procurement document change date@en skos:definition The date and time of the change. Additional information: This corresponds in eForms to BT-719 Change Procurement Documents Date WG Approval 5/11/2019 (epo:ChangeInformation)@en The date and time of the change. (epo:ChangeInformation)@en
ns1:hasPublicAccessURL owl:DatatypeProperty Has public access u r l@en skos:definition Web page where the procurement documents can be downloaded. Additional Information: This corresponds in the eForms to BT-15 Documents URL. WG Approval 09/03/2021 (epo:AccessTerm)@en Web page where the procurement documents can be downloaded. (epo:AccessTerm)@en
ns1:hasPublicationDate owl:DatatypeProperty Has publication date@en skos:definition Date of formal public issuance of the document. WG approval 20/06/2023 (epo:Document)@en Date of formal public issuance of the document. (epo:Document)@en
ns1:hasReceiptDeadline owl:DatatypeProperty Has receipt deadline@en skos:definition The time limit for receiving submissions. Additional Information This is the deadline by which the buyer must receive submissions (e.g. tenders, requests to participate, clarifications, etc.) and is not the time at which the information is submitted by the economic operator. This attribute should be used for standard forms mappings. WG Approval 21/07/2020 (epo:SubmissionTerm)@en The time limit for receiving submissions. Additional Information This is the deadline by which the buyer must receive submissions (e.g. tenders, requests to participate, clarifications, etc.) and is not the time at which the information is submitted by the economic operator. This attribute should be used for standard forms mappings. (epo:SubmissionTerm)@en
ns1:hasReceivedParticipationRequests owl:DatatypeProperty Has received participation requests@en skos:definition The amount of applications to participate from economic operators. WG Approval 12/12/2019 (epo:SubmissionStatisticalInformation)@en The amount of applications to participate from economic operators. (epo:SubmissionStatisticalInformation)@en
ns1:hasReceivedTenders owl:DatatypeProperty Has received tenders@en skos:definition The total amount of tenders received. WG Approval 12/12/2019 (epo:SubmissionStatisticalInformation)@en The total amount of tenders received. (epo:SubmissionStatisticalInformation)@en
ns1:hasReceptionDate owl:DatatypeProperty Has reception date@en skos:definition Notes: Date when a record is acknowledged by an organisation. WG Approval 12/05/2020 (epo:Document)@en Notes: Date when a record is acknowledged by an organisation. (epo:Document)@en
ns1:hasRecurrenceDescription owl:DatatypeProperty Has recurrence description@en skos:definition Any additional information about the recurrence of the Procurement. Additional Information: For example estimated timing of the Procedure. This corresponds in eForms to BT-95 Recurrence Description. (WG approval 2019-01-16) (epo:ProcurementObject)@en Any additional information about the recurrence of the Procurement. Additional Information: For example estimated timing of the Procedure. (epo:ProcurementObject)@en
ns1:hasReferenceURI owl:DatatypeProperty Has reference u r i@en skos:definition A reference to where the label specification (norms, expectations, standards and policies) can be found. WG approval 26/07/2022 (epo:CertificationLabel)@en A reference to where the label specification (norms, expectations, standards and policies) can be found. (epo:CertificationLabel)@en
ns1:hasRenewalDescription owl:DatatypeProperty Has renewal description@en skos:definition Any other information about the renewal(s). WG approval 16/04/2019 (epo:ContractTerm)@en Any other information about the renewal(s). (epo:ContractTerm)@en
ns1:hasRequestDate owl:DatatypeProperty Has request date@en skos:definition The date when the review request was submitted. Additional information: This attribute corresponds to the BT-787 Review Date in eForms. (epo:ReviewRequest)@en The date when the review request was submitted. (epo:ReviewRequest)@en
ns1:hasRestrictedAccessURL owl:DatatypeProperty Has restricted access u r l@en skos:definition The internet address with information on accessing the restricted (part of the) procurement document. Additional Information: This corresponds in eForms to BT-615 Documents Restricted URL. (epo:AccessTerm)@en The internet address with information on accessing the restricted (part of the) procurement document. (epo:AccessTerm)@en
ns1:hasReviewDeadline owl:DatatypeProperty Has review deadline@en skos:definition The time limit for review procedures. WG Approval 09/11/2021 (epo:ReviewTerm)@en The time limit for review procedures. (epo:ReviewTerm)@en
ns1:hasReviewDeadlineInformation owl:DatatypeProperty Has review deadline information@en skos:definition The description of the time limits for review procedures. WG Approval 01/10/2019 (epo:ReviewTerm)@en The description of the time limits for review procedures. (epo:ReviewTerm)@en
ns1:hasReviewIrregularityCount owl:DatatypeProperty Has review irregularity count@en skos:definition The number of requests for a given irregularity. Additional information: This attribute corresponds in eForms to BT-635 Buyer Review Requests Count. (epo:ReviewIrregularitySummary)@en The number of requests for a given irregularity. (epo:ReviewIrregularitySummary)@en
ns1:hasReviewProcedure owl:DatatypeProperty Has review procedure@en skos:definition The description of the method used to request the verification that the procedure has been carried out correctly. WG Approval 09/11/2021 (epo:ReviewTerm)@en The description of the method used to request the verification that the procedure has been carried out correctly. (epo:ReviewTerm)@en
ns1:hasReviewURL owl:DatatypeProperty Has review u r l@en skos:definition The internet address of the documents concerning the review instance. Additional information: This attribute corresponds in eForms to BT-794 Review URL. (epo:ReviewObject)@en The internet address of the documents concerning the review instance. (epo:ReviewObject)@en
ns1:hasSMEReceivedTenders owl:DatatypeProperty Has s m e received tenders@en skos:definition The amount of tenders received from micro, small and medium-sized enterprises. Additional Information: See Commission Recommendation 2003/361/EC. The ReceivedSMETenderLots is used when the size of the company is not exactly knokn. WG Approval 05/03/2020 (epo:SubmissionStatisticalInformation)@en The amount of tenders received from micro, small and medium-sized enterprises. Additional Information: See Commission Recommendation 2003/361/EC. The ReceivedSMETenderLots is used when the size of the company is not exactly knokn. (epo:SubmissionStatisticalInformation)@en
ns1:hasSubcontractingInvolved owl:DatatypeProperty Has subcontracting involved@en skos:definition List of Subcontractors and the subject matter they cover are required. Additional Information: The tenderer will ned to supply this information in the tender. WG Approval 28/02/2019 (epo:SubcontractTerm)@en List of Subcontractors and the subject matter they cover are required. Additional Information: The tenderer will ned to supply this information in the tender. (epo:SubcontractTerm)@en
ns1:hasSubcontractorsProposedAboveObligation owl:DatatypeProperty Has subcontractors proposed above obligation@en skos:definition The maximum percentage of the contract value that the contractor must subcontract. Additional information: This is used for the competitive procedure described in Title III of Directive 2009/81/EC. WG Approval 09/11/2021 (epo:SubcontractTerm)@en The maximum percentage of the contract value that the contractor must subcontract. Additional information: This is used for the competitive procedure described in Title III of Directive 2009/81/EC. (epo:SubcontractTerm)@en
ns1:hasSubjectMatter owl:DatatypeProperty Has subject matter@en skos:definition Description of the share of the contract that is to be subcontracted. Additional infromation: This can be an aggregate of several subcontracts. WG Approval 09/11/2021 (epo:SubcontractingEstimate)@en Description of the share of the contract that is to be subcontracted. Additional infromation: This can be an aggregate of several subcontracts. (epo:SubcontractingEstimate)@en
ns1:hasSuccessiveReduction owl:DatatypeProperty Has successive reduction@en skos:definition The number of solutions or tenders will be reduced in iterative evaluations for multiple staged procedures. Additional information: This refers to multiple-stage procedures (included two-stage procedures, at least). Open Procedures can be seen as one-stage procedures. WG Approval 22/08/2019 (epo:MultipleStageProcedureTerm)@en The number of solutions or tenders will be reduced in iterative evaluations for multiple staged procedures. Additional information: This refers to multiple-stage procedures (included two-stage procedures, at least). Open Procedures can be seen as one-stage procedures. (epo:MultipleStageProcedureTerm)@en
ns1:hasTotalNumberOfComplainants owl:DatatypeProperty Has total number of complainants@en skos:definition The number of economic operators that requested the buyer to review any of its decisions (e.g. the technical specifications, award decision), as set out in Art. 1(5) of Directive 89/665/EEC and Directive 92/13/EEC. Additional information: This attribute corresponds in eForms to BT-712 Buyer Review Complainants WG Approval 11/04/2019 (epo:ReviewRequestSummary)@en The number of economic operators that requested the buyer to review any of its decisions (e.g. the technical specifications, award decision), as set out in Art. 1(5) of Directive 89/665/EEC and Directive 92/13/EEC. (epo:ReviewRequestSummary)@en
ns1:hasTotalVehicles owl:DatatypeProperty Has total vehicles@en skos:definition The number of all vehicles (regardless of whether clean or not) that have either been purchased, leased, rented, hired-purchased or their use has been contractually committed to for the provision of a purchased service. Additional Information In the European Union, the legal requirements and scope for the provision of these vehicles or services are covered by Directive 2009/33/EC. WG Approval 28/07/2020 (epo:VehicleInformation)@en The number of all vehicles (regardless of whether clean or not) that have either been purchased, leased, rented, hired-purchased or their use has been contractually committed to for the provision of a purchased service. Additional Information: In the European Union, the legal requirements and scope for the provision of these vehicles or services are covered by Directive 2009/33/EC. (epo:VehicleInformation)@en
ns1:hasURL owl:DatatypeProperty Has u r l@en skos:definition The identifier of a resource. Additional Information For example: 1. The URL of the system from where to access the procurement documents; 2. The URL of the system for the submission of tender documents; 3. The URL of the system from where to download a tool to communicate with the Buyer; 4. The URL of the system used by a Technique to allow Economic Operators to exchange information with the Buyer (e.g. eAuction and DPS Systems) 5. The URL of the system used to exchange information between Buyer and EO for questions and clarifications; WG Approval 30/09/2019 (cccev:Evidence) The identifier of a resource. Additional Information For example: 1. The URL of the system from where to access the procurement documents; 2. The URL of the system for the submission of tender documents; 3. The URL of the system from where to download a tool to communicate with the Buyer; 4. The URL of the system used by a Technique to allow Economic Operators to exchange information with the Buyer (e.g. eAuction and DPS Systems) 5. The URL of the system used to exchange information between Buyer and EO for questions and clarifications; WG Approval 30/09/2019 (epo:Fund)@en The identifier of a resource. Additional Information For example: 1. The URL of the system from where to access the procurement documents; 2. The URL of the system for the submission of tender documents; 3. The URL of the system from where to download a tool to communicate with the Buyer; 4. The URL of the system used by a Technique to allow Economic Operators to exchange information with the Buyer (e.g. eAuction and DPS Systems) 5. The URL of the system used to exchange information between Buyer and EO for questions and clarifications; (cccev:Evidence) The identifier of a resource. Additional Information For example: 1. The URL of the system from where to access the procurement documents; 2. The URL of the system for the submission of tender documents; 3. The URL of the system from where to download a tool to communicate with the Buyer; 4. The URL of the system used by a Technique to allow Economic Operators to exchange information with the Buyer (e.g. eAuction and DPS Systems) 5. The URL of the system used to exchange information between Buyer and EO for questions and clarifications; (epo:Fund)@en
ns1:hasUnitDescription owl:DatatypeProperty Has unit description@en skos:definition A narrative explanation defining the units of items being counted Additional information: This could be for example individual items or pack or two. WG Approval 09/11/2021 (epo:Quantity)@en A narrative explanation defining the units of items being counted Additional information: This could be for example individual items or pack or two. (epo:Quantity)@en
ns1:hasUnverifiedTenders owl:DatatypeProperty Has unverified tenders@en skos:definition Offers received for which it has not been verified if they are admissible or inadmissible (e.g. because award criteria have been evaluated for all tenders and admissibility is checked only for the winning tender). WG Approval 28/07/2020 (epo:SubmissionStatisticalInformation)@en Offers received for which it has not been verified if they are admissible or inadmissible (e.g. because award criteria have been evaluated for all tenders and admissibility is checked only for the winning tender). (epo:SubmissionStatisticalInformation)@en
ns1:hasVersion owl:DatatypeProperty Has version@en skos:definition A number that identifies a specific state of a document. WG approval: 18/11/2021 (epo:Document)@en A number that identifies a specific state of a document. (epo:Document)@en
ns1:hasWithdrawalDate owl:DatatypeProperty Has withdrawal date@en skos:definition The date and time when the request for review was withdrawn. Additional information: This attribute corresponds in eForms to BT-797 Review Request Withdrawn Date. (epo:ReviewRequest)@en The date and time when the request for review was withdrawn. (epo:ReviewRequest)@en
ns1:hasWithdrawalReason owl:DatatypeProperty Has withdrawal reason@en skos:definition The explanation for withdrawing the request for review. Additional information: This attribute corresponds in eForms to BT-798 Review Request Withdrawn Reasons (epo:ReviewRequest)@en The explanation for withdrawing the request for review. (epo:ReviewRequest)@en
ns1:hasZeroEmissionVehicles owl:DatatypeProperty Has zero emission vehicles@en skos:definition The number of all zero-emission heavy-duty vehicles that have either been purchased, leased, rented, hired-purchased or their use has been contractually committed to for the provision of a purchased service. Additional Information In the European Union, the legal requirements and scope for the provision of these vehicles or services are covered by Directive 2009/33/EC. WG Approval 28/07/2020 (epo:VehicleInformation)@en The number of all zero-emission heavy-duty vehicles that have either been purchased, leased, rented, hired-purchased or their use has been contractually committed to for the provision of a purchased service. Additional Information: In the European Union, the legal requirements and scope for the provision of these vehicles or services are covered by Directive 2009/33/EC. (epo:VehicleInformation)@en
ns1:isAccelerated owl:DatatypeProperty Is accelerated@en skos:definition Statement about the fact that the procedure will be reduced due to a state of urgency. Additional Information This modifies the time limit for the receipt of requests to participate or the receipt of tenders. WG Approval 20/08/2019 (epo:Procedure)@en Statement about the fact that the procedure will be reduced due to a state of urgency. Additional Information This modifies the time limit for the receipt of requests to participate or the receipt of tenders. (epo:Procedure)@en
ns1:isAdvancedElectronicSignatureRequired owl:DatatypeProperty Is advanced electronic signature required@en skos:definition Advanced or qualified electronic signature or seal (as defined in Regulation (EU) No 910/2014) is required. The submitted information is required to be signed electronically. Additional Information: Signature can be defined as "data in electronic form which is attached to or logically associated with other data in electronic form and which is used by the signatory to sign. For more details on the meaning and uses of electronic signature you may consult different authoritative sources, a relevant one being for instance the Regulation (EU) 910/2014 on electronic identification and trust services for electronic transactions in the internal market. WG Approval 21/07/2020 (epo:SubmissionTerm)@en Advanced or qualified electronic signature or seal (as defined in Regulation (EU) No 910/2014) is required. The submitted information is required to be signed electronically. Additional Information: Signature can be defined as "data in electronic form which is attached to or logically associated with other data in electronic form and which is used by the signatory to sign. For more details on the meaning and uses of electronic signature you may consult different authoritative sources, a relevant one being for instance the Regulation (EU) 910/2014 on electronic identification and trust services for electronic transactions in the internal market. (epo:SubmissionTerm)@en
ns1:isCompetitionTerminated owl:DatatypeProperty Is competition terminated@en skos:definition No further contracts will be awarded in this procedure. Additional Information: This can be instantiated in the post award phase. PIN for Competition needs to be signaled. This field can be used even if no contracts are awarded in the contract award notice. This corresponds in eForms to BT-756 PIN Competition Termination. (epo:ProcurementProcessInformation)@en No further contracts will be awarded in this procedure. Additional Information: This can be instantiated in the post award phase. PIN for Competition needs to be signaled. This field can be used even if no contracts are awarded in the contract award notice. (epo:ProcurementProcessInformation)@en
ns1:isContractingEntity owl:DatatypeProperty Is contracting entity@en skos:definition Role of entities, which: (a) are contracting authorities or public undertakings and which pursue one of the activities referred to in Articles 8 to 14 of the Directive 2014/25/EU. (b) when they are not contracting authorities or public undertakings, have as one of their activities any of the activities referred to in Articles 8 to 14, or any combination thereof and operate on the basis of special or exclusive rights granted by a competent authority of a Member State. Additional Information The indicator is needed in order to discriminate between those contracts where the Contracting Entity acts as a Contracting Authority undergoing the limits and the rules of Directive 24 and those where it acts as a Contracting Entity, with certain relaxed constraints. For example, the Contracting Entities have different thresholds for the application of Directive 24 if compared with Contracting Authorities. WG Approval 28/04/2020 (epo:Buyer)@en Role of entities, which: (a) are contracting authorities or public undertakings and which pursue one of the activities referred to in Articles 8 to 14 of the Directive 2014/25/EU. (b) when they are not contracting authorities or public undertakings, have as one of their activities any of the activities referred to in Articles 8 to 14, or any combination thereof and operate on the basis of special or exclusive rights granted by a competent authority of a Member State. Additional Information: The indicator is needed in order to discriminate between those contracts where the Contracting Entity acts as a Contracting Authority undergoing the limits and the rules of Directive 24 and those where it acts as a Contracting Entity, with certain relaxed constraints. For example, the Contracting Entities have different thresholds for the application of Directive 24 if compared with Contracting Authorities. (epo:Buyer)@en
ns1:isCoveredByGPA owl:DatatypeProperty Is covered by g p a@en skos:definition Specifies whether the Agreement on Government Procurement (GPA) applies. Additional information: The GPA aims to establish a multilateral framework of balanced rights and obligations relating to public contracts with a view to achieving the liberalization and expansion of world trade. This corresponds in the e Forms to BT-115 GPA Coverage. WG Approval 15/10/2019 (epo:ProcurementObject)@en Specifies whether the Agreement on Government Procurement (GPA) applies. Additional information: The GPA aims to establish a multilateral framework of balanced rights and obligations relating to public contracts with a view to achieving the liberalization and expansion of world trade. (epo:ProcurementObject)@en
ns1:isDPSTerminated owl:DatatypeProperty Is d p s terminated@en skos:definition End of the Dynamic Purchase System (DPS). Additional Information: This property can be used in the contract award notice even if no contracts are awarded. WG Approval 22/11/2019 (epo:ProcurementProcessInformation)@en End of the Dynamic Purchase System (DPS). Additional Information: This property can be used in the contract award notice even if no contracts are awarded. (epo:ProcurementProcessInformation)@en
ns1:isDesignContest owl:DatatypeProperty Is design contest@en skos:definition A competition which enables the buyer to acquire a plan or design via a jury. Additional information: Design contests have traditionally mostly been used in the fields of town and country planning, architecture and engineering or data processing, other purposes, such as to obtain plans for financial engineering The contest may include or not the award of prizes; WG approval 04-02-2021 (epo:Procedure)@en A competition which enables the buyer to acquire a plan or design via a jury. Additional information: Design contests have traditionally mostly been used in the fields of town and country planning, architecture and engineering or data processing, other purposes, such as to obtain plans for financial engineering The contest may include or not the award of prizes; (epo:Procedure)@en
ns1:isGuaranteeRequired owl:DatatypeProperty Is guarantee required@en skos:definition The submitted information must include a financial commitment to be used in case of default. Additional Information: See the additional information provided in the definition of the 'Guarantee Description' element. WG Approval 21/07/20 (epo:SubmissionTerm)@en The submitted information must include a financial commitment to be used in case of default. Additional Information: See the additional information provided in the definition of the 'Guarantee Description' element. (epo:SubmissionTerm)@en
ns1:isListedCompany owl:DatatypeProperty Is listed company@en skos:definition Public companies listed on a stock exchange and subject to disclosure requirements (either by stock exchange rules or through law or enforceable means), which impose requirements to ensure adequate transparency of beneficial ownership. Additional Information: In eForms this indicator is used when the nationality of beneficial owner is not provided because the Economic Operator is registered in a regulated market that is subject to disclosure requirements consistent with Union law or subject to equivalent international standards which ensure adequate transparency of ownership information. WG Approval 21/11/2019 (epo:Business)@en Public companies listed on a stock exchange and subject to disclosure requirements (either by stock exchange rules or through law or enforceable means), which impose requirements to ensure adequate transparency of beneficial ownership. Additional Information: In eForms this indicator is used when the nationality of beneficial owner is not provided because the Economic Operator is registered in a regulated market that is subject to disclosure requirements consistent with Union law or subject to equivalent international standards which ensure adequate transparency of ownership information. (epo:Business)@en
ns1:isMultipleTenderSubmissionAllowed owl:DatatypeProperty Is multiple tender submission allowed@en skos:definition Tenderers may submit more than one competing tenders. WG Approval 10/10/2019 (epo:SubmissionTerm)@en Tenderers may submit more than one competing tenders. (epo:SubmissionTerm)@en
ns1:isOneLotOnlyAllowed owl:DatatypeProperty Is one lot only allowed@en skos:definition Indicates whether tenders may be submitted for only one Lot. Additional information: This field is used to complement the SubmissionTerms (which are at the Lot level) for the Procedure level which is covered by the regulation (EU)-2015-1986 (modeled in the TED Standard Forms). WG approval 23/08/2022 (epo:ProcedureTerm)@en Indicates whether tenders may be submitted for only one Lot. Additional information: This field is used to complement the SubmissionTerms (which are at the Lot level) for the Procedure level which is covered by the regulation (EU)-2015-1986 (modeled in the TED Standard Forms). (epo:ProcedureTerm)@en
ns1:isProcurementDocumentChanged owl:DatatypeProperty Is procurement document changed@en skos:definition One or more procurement documents have been changed. Additional information: This corresponds in eForms to BT-718 Change Procurement Documents WG Approval 05/11/2019 (epo:ChangeInformation)@en One or more procurement documents have been changed. (epo:ChangeInformation)@en
ns1:isProcurementDocumentRestricted owl:DatatypeProperty Is procurement document restricted@en skos:definition The access to certain procurement documents is restricted. Additional Information: This corresponds in eForms to BT-14 Documents Restricted. WG Approval 10/10/2019 (epo:AccessTerm)@en The access to certain procurement documents is restricted. (epo:AccessTerm)@en
ns1:isRecurrent owl:DatatypeProperty Is recurrent@en skos:definition The Procurement being notified is likely to be included in another procedure in the foreseeable future. Additional Information: For example, a regularly re-tendered municipal service. This does not include awarding multiple contracts within a single qualification system, framework agreement, or a dynamic purchasing system. This corresponds in eForms to BT-94 Recurrence. WG Approval 12/05/2020 (epo:ProcurementObject)@en The Procurement being notified is likely to be included in another procedure in the foreseeable future. Additional Information: For example, a regularly re-tendered municipal service. This does not include awarding multiple contracts within a single qualification system, framework agreement, or a dynamic purchasing system. (epo:ProcurementObject)@en
ns1:isRenewalIndicator owl:DatatypeProperty Is renewal indicator@en skos:definition Indicates whether the contract is subject to a renewal clause. WG Approval 09/11/2021 (epo:ContractTerm)@en Indicates whether the contract is subject to a renewal clause. (epo:ContractTerm)@en
ns1:isSMESuitable owl:DatatypeProperty Is s m e suitable@en skos:definition The Lot is suitable for small and medium enterprises (SMEs). Additional Information This allows the buyer to make emphasis on the fact that the procedure has been designed having SMEs in mind. This indicator is also to be reflected in the selection criteria. For example, number of employees and turnover are applicable to the definition of an SME. WG Approval 15/10/2019 (epo:ProcurementObject)@en The Lot is suitable for small and medium enterprises (SMEs). Additional Information This allows the buyer to make emphasis on the fact that the procedure has been designed having SMEs in mind. This indicator is also to be reflected in the selection criteria. For example, number of employees and turnover are applicable to the definition of an SME. (epo:ProcurementObject)@en
ns1:isToBeRelaunched owl:DatatypeProperty Is to be relaunched@en skos:definition Indicator of whether the procurement object is to be relaunched. Additional information: This can be instantiated in the post award phase. This corresponds in eForms to BT-634 Procurement Relaunch. WG Approval: 18/01/2022 (epo:ProcurementProcessInformation)@en Indicator of whether the procurement object is to be relaunched. Additional information: This can be instantiated in the post award phase. (epo:ProcurementProcessInformation)@en
ns1:isUsedForCandidateRestriction owl:DatatypeProperty Is used for candidate restriction@en skos:definition The criterion will be used to select the candidates to be invited for the second stage of a multistage procedure. Additional Information: This property is only used if a maximum number of candidates was foreseen in the procedure. This corresponds in eForms to BT-40 Selection Criteria Second Stage Invite (epo:SelectionCriterion)@en The criterion will be used to select the candidates to be invited for the second stage of a multistage procedure. Additional Information: This property is only used if a maximum number of candidates was foreseen in the procedure. (epo:SelectionCriterion)@en
ns1:isVariant owl:DatatypeProperty Is variant@en skos:definition Alternative solution to fulfil the buyer's needs as opposed to solutions indicated in the procurement documents. Additional Information: The permission to offer variants is only allowed if specified in a Contract Notice or a Prior Information Notice that used as a means for calling for a competition. The buyer lays out minimum requirements in the procurement documents that must be respected by tenderers submitting variants. WG Approval 29/05/2019 (epo:Tender)@en Alternative solution to fulfil the buyer's needs as opposed to solutions indicated in the procurement documents. Additional Information: The permission to offer variants is only allowed if specified in a Contract Notice or a Prior Information Notice that used as a means for calling for a competition. The buyer lays out minimum requirements in the procurement documents that must be respected by tenderers submitting variants. (epo:Tender)@en
ns1:isWithdrawn owl:DatatypeProperty Is withdrawn@en skos:definition The review request was withdrawn. Additional information: This attribute corresponds in eForms to BT-796 Review Request Withdrawn. (epo:ReviewRequest)@en The review request was withdrawn. (epo:ReviewRequest)@en
